en-US.title: SnakeTastic
en-US.subtitle: Classic Snake. No Ads.
en-US.description:
Classic Snake, rebuilt for one shared phone: play solo, take on the CPU, or go head to head with a friend. No ads, no accounts.

• Solo, Vs CPU (Garter, Rattler, or King Cobra), and 2 Player on one device
• Five arenas: Open, Pillars, Gauntlet, Portals, and Underpass
• Three speeds, three grid sizes, and Wrap Edges
• Six optional powerups, from a speed boost to reversed controls
• Player profiles, stats, and 33 achievements
• Retro sound effects and haptics
• Plays offline

Part of the Tastic family of games. Your player profiles are shared with the other Tastic games on your device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/Snake
